title: Kunti Putra
desc: Surya, an aid to the don, is feared by all the townspeople due to his association. He is assigned a job to kidnap the daughter of a wealthy businessman. However, he begins to fall in love with her.

title: Hostel Hudugaru Bekagiddare
desc: A group of students who are suspects of a boy's hostel warden's death, make a plan to hide his corpse after they find a note left by him.

title: Yajamana
desc: Devi Shetty, a cruel gangster, is out to plunder a village's oil resources and ruin its inhabitants' livelihood. However, the son-in-law of the village head, Krishna, stands in his way.

title: Seetharama Kalyana
desc: Arya is an altruistic individual who constantly sacrifices his happiness for his loved ones. Consequently, his romance with innocent Geetha faces severe hurdles.

title: Sirai
desc: A priest and his wife move to a new village where they face a traumatic event that forces them into an unconventional living situation.

title: Kalki 2898 AD
desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a group of people set out to save a woman pregnant with Lord Vishnu's 10th and final avatar, Kalki, from an evil supreme god-king, Yaskin.
